definitions.explanation: What someone has to say in their defense or to express their viewpoint.
A reason or objection someone raises.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言|い}い{分|ぶん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦あげよう→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Let's also hear what he has to say.

examples.japanese: ⟦{双方|そうほう}→双方：11859_souhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言|い}い{分|ぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to hear both sides of the argument.

examples.japanese: {言|い}い{分|ぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦みろ→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: If you have something to say, say it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言|い}い{分|ぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Her excuse is always the same.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}した→遅刻する：03465_chikoku⟧{言|い}い{分|ぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせて→聞かせる：20926_kikaseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me your excuse for being late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{言|い}い{分|ぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦{聞|き}こえない→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{黙|だま}って→黙る：02287_damaru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: No matter what you say, it just sounds like excuses, so it's better to stay quiet.

notes:
FORMATION:
⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (portion, share)

USAGE:
・{言|い}い{分|ぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have something to say)
・{言|い}い{分|ぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear someone out)
・{言|い}い{分|ぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (one's argument is accepted)
・{言|い}い{分|ぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ (to acknowledge someone's point)

NUANCE:
Implies the speaker feels they have a valid point or justification. Often used in conflict situations or when someone feels misunderstood.
